name: tool_idempotency
py_module: (contract — no LIVE python twin; self-contained parity gate)
notes: Process-local idempotency cache (omap-backed) preventing double side effects on retry: same key within TTL returns the cached result WITHOUT re-executing the handler. Explicit 'idempotency_key' arg overrides key material; TTL expiry drops stale entries. Wired into registry_dispatch (both main + repaired paths): lookup-before-exec + store-on-success. With tool_registry_shutdown() to free the cache.
